title: nan
key_contribution: Presents an inertial navigation filter using magnetometer, Pitot tube, and air vanes to reduce GNSS-denied navigation errors for fixed-wing UAVs, validated via high-fidelity Monte Carlo simulations.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
